parsed.explanation: The function `lookup` constructs an SQL query dynamically using f-string formatting. If the `username` contains user-supplied input (in this case, any non-digit string), it will be directly incorporated into the query without proper sanitization or escaping. This allows an attacker to inject malicious SQL code, potentially retrieving unauthorized data or performing arbitrary operations on the database.
